title: Acquirer: Pioneer Construction Materials Pty Ltd; Target: EB Mawsons & Sons Pty Ltd

body_sections.Summary: Proposed tolling arrangement for pre-mixed concrete batching between Pioneer and Mawsons at Castlemaine
body_sections.Market definition: the market for pre-mixed concrete in and around Castlemaine.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The proposed arrangement only concerns the production of pre-mix concrete, and both parties to the arrangement have indicated that they will pursue independent sales, marketing and delivery of pre-mix concrete in Castlemaine.  Mawsons is only a small player in the market, and market inquiries indicated that Mawsons is not an especially vigorous competitor to Pioneer. In light of these factors it was not clear that the proposed tolling arrangement would lead to a substantial lessening of competition.
